ideas.name: Cross-asset carry: long high, short low
ideas.claim: Carry predicts returns in the cross section and time series across several asset classes including currencies; carry trades go long high-carry and short low-carry securities.
ideas.quote: This predictability underlies the strong returns to "carry trades" that go long high-carry and short low-carry securities,

rules.market: currencies (and equities, bonds, commodities, Treasuries, credit, index options)

ideas.claimed_result: Carry predicts returns in cross section and time series; carry strategies do poorly in episodes that coincide with global recessions
required_data: FX spot and forward or interest rate data

ideas.name: FX forward-discount slope: long high-rate currencies
ideas.claim: High interest rate currencies load more on a global slope risk factor, which accounts for most of the cross-sectional variation in average excess returns between high and low interest rate currencies.
ideas.quote: By investing in high interest rate currencies and borrowing in low interest rate currencies, US investors load up on global risk, particularly during bad times.

rules.entry: invest in high interest rate currencies, borrow in low interest rate currencies (portfolios sorted on forward discounts)

required_data: FX spot and forward rates or interest rate differentials
